title: Working with Louis and Leon Prima and the clubs
summary: He played with Louis Prima, took over his band, followed the club moves, and worked with Leon Prima at the 500 Club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We had, originally there were a place called Beverly Gardens, still called Beverly Gardens, the street in Metry. And there was a club out there, Leon Prima bought the club. And Louis had the band, we played with him quite a while. Then we moved, moved in town here where they, it was a Toyssey's restaurant and they remodeled it and made a nightclub of it. Called it Prima's and then later the Shim Sham and later the Moulin Rouge on Bourbon Street. We're Syros now, has it. We worked there quite a while. You worked with Leon a while too, didn't you? Yeah, I worked with Leon at the 500 Club quite a while. I remember that.
A couple years. I was here. See, what years were those?
That's right after, I played at the St. Charles Theater for three seasons. That's right after that, that was around 48 I think. Around that time. Let's see, I think, yeah around that time.
Were you with Sharky before you went with Leon Prima? Yeah, I was with Sharky in 1936, 1937.
No, I mean in the, well you were alternating with Sharky at the Famous Door.
In between that time somewhere as you see, in around that time.

Around that time, yeah that's how I remember. Yeah, because I had played at the 500 Club with my own band and then I left the 500 Club and went to Dan's and from Dan's I went to the Famous Door and then I worked at the Latin Quarter and I think then I went back to the 500 Club with Leon then.
